headline: Penking item farmer
title: Penking | Mining Worker With Fire Drop Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Farming Fire Pals for drops in Palworld one point zero? Penking is a Water and Ice Pal whose partner skill, Brave Sailor, makes Fire Pals drop forty to eighty percent more items when defeated. At base it works Mining level three and Transporting level three, plus Watering, Handiwork and Cooling at level two. Will you use Penking? Comment below!
description: Penking in Palworld 1.0 is a Water and Ice Pal with Mining level three and a Fire drop bonus.
